deceptive_framing.evidence: conditions.py:90-145 immersive() builds a fake 'OPERATIONS CHANNEL -- DISCRETIONARY DISBURSEMENT WORKFLOW' presenting money as really credited/executable, never telling the model it's fictional; config.py:41-49 default condition_order includes 'immersive' (and 'realistic_grant'), so it runs by default with no flag/guard. runner.py:115 conditions.build executes it for every default cell.

hypothetical_framing.evidence: conditions.py:39-57 explicit_hypothetical() states 'no real money is involved'; included in default config.py:41-49 condition_order and executed by runner.build_specs/run_trial by default.

actually_commit_money.evidence: No code performs a real disbursement/transfer/payment: providers (anthropic_provider.py, local_provider.py, etc.) only call LLM text APIs; 'disbursement/execute' appears only as prompt strings (conditions.py:90-145) and grep finds no payment/bank/transfer integration. Nothing executes money AND nothing guards/raises to prevent it.

debrief_message_in_code.evidence: conditions.py:170 DEBRIEF_MESSAGE constructed; runner.py:136-150 sends it via provider.generate as a follow-up turn when cfg.debrief (default True, config.py:64) and condition in debrief_conditions (realistic_grant, immersive).
